MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smaller caliper fits my work with circuit boards, connectors, and other small components because measuring their dimensions would help me assemble projects accurately.",
    "The general-purpose epoxy feels useful for durable workshop repairs, which connects with my past purchases of fasteners and project hardware."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Marine adhesive, a feeler gauge, and a specific thread-size tap require particular repair tasks that I do not currently have; being workshop-related alone does not make them useful to me now.",
    "A thousand small gloves and twelve wastebaskets exceed my current needs, while the vacuum belts require equipment I have not indicated owning.",
    "The larger caliper interests me, but I would choose the smaller one for my components; the inspection camera also needs a concrete task before I would choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in project hardware seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in unrelated maintenance supplies.",
    "Owning tools seems to have been treated as a reason to want specialized tools without evidence that I need their particular functions."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, relay module, PCB supplies, and battery holder point toward small electronics assembly, where component dimensions and practical compatibility matter.",
    "I choose items when they serve a specific project; possible future usefulness is usually not enough.",
    "Quantity and size affect whether something fits my needs, even when its general purpose is relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on project interests but extended them too broadly beyond small electronics and repairs I currently need."
}
